items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the album called New York Reunion where Joe Henderson comes back... The Real McCoy... Joe Henderson, Ron Carter, and Elvin

ctx.x: Now when you say Joe, are you talking about Joe Zawinul or Joe Ford?
Joe Zawinul, oh yeah that’s right, we got a lot of Joe’s here (laughs). This Joe that Joe.
